name: DearlyDialy - Dearly Diary
original_name: DearlyDialy ディアリーダイアリー
source:
To repay a debt, a female private tutor earns money by doing her job, and 
perhaps selling herself in this text adventure game with some simulator elements.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE245028.html]DLsite English[/url]]
